notes: Fiscal year 2025 ended December 28, 2025 (52-week year). Sources: FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0000200406-26-000016, filed February 11, 2026) and 2026 proxy (DEF 14A, accession 0000200406-26-000063, filed March 11, 2026); ownership as of February 24, 2026, when 2,408,613,219 shares were outstanding. DUATO: Chairman and CEO; less than 1% (the proxy says each listed individual owns less than 1%; no percentage is given), so pctEconomic is null. His 1,407,667 shares include 1,051,370 shares underlying options or stock units exercisable or vesting within 60 days. Because Mr. Duato and Mr. Wolk serve as trustees of Johnson Family Trusts, they are deemed to 'control' an additional 4,869,671 shares in which they have no economic interest; those shares are not in his figure. HOLDERS: the proxy bases the 5% holders solely on Schedule 13G filings. Vanguard's is an amendment filed February 5, 2026 (the proxy does not state the holding date, so asOf is null); BlackRock's and State Street's still rest on filings from January 2024 and are stale; the proxy gives only filing dates, so asOf is null for all three. BUYBACKS: the 10-K says its open-market common stock purchases 'are made as part of a systematic plan to meet the needs of the Company's compensation programs'; the $5,953m is the full cash-flow line. STOCK COMP: the cash-flow add-back of $1,354m; the stock-compensation note gives the compensation cost charged against income as $1.4 billion. PLAN: null; no broad employee stock purchase plan is described in the 10-K. GEOGRAPHY values are rounded from millions.

footprint.notes: J&J publishes no state or country breakdown. Regions come from two sources on different bases: (1) the FY2025 10-K Item 2 manufacturing-facility counts by major geographic area (U.S. 22, Europe 22, Western Hemisphere ex-U.S. 7, Africa/Asia/Pacific 12; total 63); (2) the 2025 Health for Humanity Report (the edition covering 2025; its imprint page says it was published June 15, 2026), the same PDF as before, with rows moved from its 2024 column to its 2025 column, for employees by region (total 139,769) and supplier spend contracted by region (total $32.3 billion). The HFH regions (Asia Pacific, EMEA, Latin America, North America) and the 10-K regions are differently defined and do not list member countries, so countries is null for every region. No newer edition found (checked 2026-11-24): healthforhumanityreport.jnj.com/2026/ returns 404 and the landing page still redirects to 2025/. The 10-K headcount (approximately 138,200 employees) differs from the HFH 139,769 because of definitions and dates (the HFH excludes fixed-term staff and recently acquired companies).

pay.notes: Employees: the 10-K's head count of individual employees at December 28, 2025 (140,800); it also reports 138,200 full-time equivalent positions, the figure used in its business description. Contingent workers are excluded. Payroll: the 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median for 2025 is used (same year as the head count); J&J says it assumed the 8% of employees missing from its compensation database are paid less than the median.
